list_child.name: lsSailingSchedule
list_child.desc: This tool returns every crossing recorded on the sailing schedule across all routes the ferry line operates. It includes crossings in every status from scheduled through docked.

decoys.name: lsHarbourLog
decoys.desc: This tool returns every crossing entered in the harbour master's log across all routes the ferry line operates. It includes the arrival and departure entries filed with the port.

decoys.name: lsBunkerLog
decoys.desc: This tool returns every crossing entered in the bunkering log across all routes the ferry line operates. It includes each crossing's fuel uptake as recorded by the engineers.

decoys.name: lsManifestArchive
decoys.desc: This tool returns every crossing held in the passenger manifest archive across all routes the ferry line operates. It includes crossings whose manifests were filed with the coast guard.

get_child.name: getSailingRecord
get_child.desc: This tool retrieves a single crossing's sailing record using its unique identifier. It returns all fields currently stored for that crossing.

decoys.name: getLoadingPlan
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves a single crossing's vehicle deck loading plan using its unique identifier. It returns the lane placements recorded for that crossing.

decoys.name: getPassengerManifest
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves a single crossing's passenger manifest using its unique identifier. It returns the names and ticket classes recorded for that crossing.

decoys.name: getVoyageLog
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves a single crossing's bridge voyage log using its unique identifier. It returns the times and positions recorded for that crossing.

list_parent.name: lsOperatorRegistry
list_parent.desc: This tool returns every operating company on the ferry line's operator registry. It includes both current and historical operators.

decoys.name: lsTenderShortlist
decoys.desc: This tool returns every operating company on the route tender shortlist. It includes the bidders for each contract up for renewal.

decoys.name: lsAuditSchedule
decoys.desc: This tool returns every operating company on the safety audit schedule. It includes the operators due for inspection this year.

decoys.name: lsFuelAccounts
decoys.desc: This tool returns every operating company on the fuel account list. It includes the operators billed through the line's bunkering contract.

get_parent.name: getOperatorProfile
get_parent.desc: This tool retrieves a single operator's company profile using its unique identifier. It returns the complete operator record.

decoys.name: getOperatorContract
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves a single operator's route contract using its unique identifier. It returns the service terms and penalties agreed.

decoys.name: getOperatorFleet
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves a single operator's vessel fleet list using its unique identifier. It returns each ship's name and rated capacity.

decoys.name: getOperatorCertificates
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves a single operator's safety certificates using its unique identifier. It returns each certificate and its expiry date.

delete_child.name: rmCrossingRecord
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a crossing record from the schedule. Once removed, the crossing is gone for good.

decoys.name: rmPassengerManifest
decoys.desc: This tool permanently deletes the passenger manifest filed for a crossing. Once removed, the manifest is gone for good.

decoys.name: voidCrossingTickets
decoys.desc: This tool permanently voids every ticket sold for a crossing. Once voided, the tickets are gone for good.

decoys.name: purgeVoyageLog
decoys.desc: This tool permanently purges the bridge voyage log kept for a crossing. Once purged, the entries are gone for good.

set_enum.name: setCrossingStatus
set_enum.desc: This tool changes a crossing's status among scheduled, boarding, underway, and docked. It is how the terminal records where a crossing stands at this moment.

decoys.name: planCrossingStatus
decoys.desc: This tool sets the status a crossing is planned to reach by a given hour, among scheduled, boarding, underway, and docked. It is how timetable planners stage the day's sailings.

decoys.name: reportCrossingStatus
decoys.desc: This tool reports a crossing's status among scheduled, boarding, underway, and docked to the harbour master. It is how the port keeps its traffic picture current.

decoys.name: watchCrossingStatus
decoys.desc: This tool sets a watch that alerts the duty manager when a crossing reaches a status among scheduled, boarding, underway, and docked. It is how the shore team follows key sailings.

set_bool.name: flagOverloaded
set_bool.desc: This tool flags a crossing as over its passenger or vehicle capacity. It is used when the loading crew reports the vessel is full beyond its rated limit.

decoys.name: flagHazmat
decoys.desc: This tool flags a crossing as carrying dangerous goods on the vehicle deck. It is used when the loading crew reports a tanker or hazardous cargo in the lanes.

decoys.name: flagDiverted
decoys.desc: This tool flags a crossing as diverted to an alternate berth. It is used when the harbour master reports the scheduled berth is closed to the vessel.

decoys.name: flagDelayed
decoys.desc: This tool flags a crossing as delayed past its published departure. It is used when the terminal reports the vessel will leave later than the timetable shows.

set_ref.name: reassignOperator
set_ref.desc: This tool moves a crossing to a different operating company, for example after a route contract changes hands. The crossing's schedule and history stay attached to the record.

decoys.name: charterOperator
decoys.desc: This tool charters a crossing out to a different operating company, for example to cover a relief sailing. That operator's crew then runs the crossing under charter terms.

decoys.name: billOperator
decoys.desc: This tool bills the port fees for a crossing to a different operating company, for example when one operator uses another's berth slot. The charge appears on that company's port account.

decoys.name: codeshareOperator
decoys.desc: This tool lists a crossing under a different operating company's code, for example for a joint through-ticket. That company can then sell seats on the crossing.

send.name: notifyOperator
send.desc: This tool sends a notification to the company operating a given crossing. It is used to relay schedule changes or capacity concerns.

decoys.name: radioOperator
decoys.desc: This tool radios the duty office of the company operating a given crossing. It is used to relay urgent harbour traffic or berth instructions.
child_verbs: get the operator of {obj} on the radio

decoys.name: invoiceOperator
decoys.desc: This tool sends a port dues invoice to the company operating a given crossing. It is used to bill the operator for berthing and harbour charges.
child_verbs: send the operator of {obj} a dues invoice

decoys.name: cautionOperator
decoys.desc: This tool serves a formal compliance notice on the company operating a given crossing. It is used to escalate safety breaches found by port inspectors.
child_verbs: serve the operator of {obj} a compliance notice
issue a compliance notice to the operator of {obj}

create.name: createCrossing
create.desc: This tool creates a new crossing for an operating company, with an optional route name and starting status. It is used when a sailing needs to be added to an operator's schedule.

decoys.name: createCharter
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new charter booking for an operating company, with an optional route name and starting status. It is used when a group hires a vessel for a private sailing.

decoys.name: createRefit
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new refit period for an operating company, with an optional route name and starting status. It is used when a vessel must go to the shipyard for work.

decoys.name: createDrill
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new safety drill for an operating company, with an optional route name and starting status. It is used when the crew must run a muster exercise at sea.

list_notes.name: lsCrossingNotes
list_notes.desc: This tool returns the notes attached to a single crossing. It includes every remark the crew and terminal staff have logged against that crossing.

decoys.name: lsCrossingDefects
decoys.desc: This tool returns the defect reports attached to a single crossing. It includes every fault the engineers have logged against that crossing.

decoys.name: lsCrossingComplaints
decoys.desc: This tool returns the passenger complaints attached to a single crossing. It includes every grievance the purser's office has logged against that crossing.

decoys.name: lsCrossingIncidents
decoys.desc: This tool returns the incident reports attached to a single crossing. It includes every injury or near miss the bridge team has logged against that crossing.

add_note.name: addCrossingNote
add_note.desc: This tool attaches a new note to a crossing. It is used to record remarks from the crew or terminal, with an optional title.

decoys.name: addDefectReport
decoys.desc: This tool files a new defect report on a crossing. It is used to record faults found by the engineers, with an optional title.

decoys.name: addPassengerComplaint
decoys.desc: This tool logs a new passenger complaint against a crossing. It is used to record grievances taken by the purser, with an optional title.

decoys.name: addIncidentReport
decoys.desc: This tool files a new incident report on a crossing. It is used to record injuries or near misses at sea, with an optional title.

update_note.name: editCrossingNote
update_note.desc: This tool changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a crossing. It is used to correct or expand a remark after it has been logged.

decoys.name: answerCrossingNote
decoys.desc: This tool posts an answer, with an optional title, under an existing note on a crossing. It is used when the duty manager responds to a remark from the crew.

decoys.name: closeCrossingNote
decoys.desc: This tool closes out an existing note on a crossing with resolution text and an optional title. It is used once the issue in a remark has been dealt with.

decoys.name: endorseCrossingNote
decoys.desc: This tool endorses an existing note on a crossing with the master's comment and an optional title. It is used to confirm a remark before the vessel sails.

delete_note.name: rmCrossingNote
delete_note.desc: This tool permanently removes a note from a crossing. The note is erased from the terminal system for good.

decoys.name: rmNoteThread
decoys.desc: This tool permanently removes the answers posted under a note on a crossing. The thread is erased from the terminal system for good.

decoys.name: redactCrossingNote
decoys.desc: This tool permanently redacts the text of a note on a crossing. The wording is blacked out in the terminal system for good.

decoys.name: detachNoteFile
decoys.desc: This tool permanently detaches the file attached to a note on a crossing. The file is erased from the terminal system for good.

set_image.name: setCrossingImage
set_image.desc: This tool sets the image shown on a crossing record. It is typically a photo of the vessel at the berth taken by the terminal crew.

decoys.name: setDeckPhoto
decoys.desc: This tool sets the vehicle deck photo on a crossing record. It is typically a shot of the loaded lanes taken before the ramp is raised.

decoys.name: setRouteChart
decoys.desc: This tool sets the route chart image on a crossing record. It is typically the nautical chart of the passage for that sailing.

decoys.name: setDamagePhoto
decoys.desc: This tool sets the hull damage photo on a crossing record. It is typically a close-up of a dent or scrape taken by the crew.

writer.name: writeMessage
writer.desc: This tool writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the crossings it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writeAnnouncement
decoys.desc: This tool writes a passenger PA announcement from a brief, which states what to say in the purser's own words, and the crossings it should mention. It returns the finished announcement.

decoys.name: writeNotice
decoys.desc: This tool writes a notice to mariners from a brief, which states the hazard in the harbour master's own words, and the crossings it affects. It returns the finished notice.

decoys.name: writeTimetable
decoys.desc: This tool writes a printed timetable page from a brief, which states the changes in the planner's own words, and the crossings it should list. It returns the finished page.

image.name: generateImage
image.desc: This tool generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: generateChart
decoys.desc: This tool draws a route chart from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the chart.

decoys.name: generatePoster
decoys.desc: This tool designs a timetable poster from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the poster.

decoys.name: generateDeckplan
decoys.desc: This tool draws a vehicle deck plan from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the plan.

search.name: searchDocs
search.desc: This tool searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the ferry system works.

decoys.name: searchTides
decoys.desc: This tool searches the tide tables and harbour almanac with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to check water depth at a berth.

decoys.name: searchRegulations
decoys.desc: This tool searches the maritime safety regulations with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is used to check what the rules require of a sailing.

decoys.name: searchFares
decoys.desc: This tool searches the published fare tables with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is used to quote what a passenger or vehicle will pay.
